assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness accompanied by transient neurological symptoms suggestive of a transient cerebral ischemic attack.
The G45.9 diagnosis code is used.
The R42 diagnosis code is used.
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring is ordered.
The CPT code for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring is 93229.
The monitoring is ordered to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances during symptom onset.
The clinical indication note documents the ordering of the monitoring.
